_meta.source: TB_AI_Audit_Final_Detailed_Team_Final.md sec 8.2 (risk rating methodology), sec 3.2 (data sufficiency grading)
_meta.purpose: Atomic-rule weights for the composite risk score, and the mapping-coverage thresholds that decide confidence wording.
_meta.extraction_note: Weights generated from the Python literal by AST read. The two mapping-confidence thresholds were previously defined only inside build_data_sufficiency_grade; build_risk_indicators had no equivalent and reported a hardcoded 'Unknown'. Both tools now read these, so they cannot drift.
_meta.amend_policy: A score is the SUM of every triggered rule's weight, capped at 100. Bands: >75 Critical, >=50 High, >=25 Medium, else Low. Raising one weight shifts the whole population across bands -- change deliberately, and re-run the acceptance set afterwards.
